description: This file defines the 'Membership' class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for report display fields related to membership. It extends a base class 'ListableDisplayField' and overrides methods to specify the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a report display field for membership data, extending 'ListableDisplayField' to specify class-specific details such as DTO, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field, which is 'Dto\Membership'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides entity alias mappings; in this case, returns an array with 'membership' as the alias.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields to be included, here 'employee.empNumber'.
